claims.text: The Senate confirmed him on 8 May 1972: the clerk 'read the nomination of Harald Bernard Malmgren, of the District of Columbia, to be a Deputy Special Representative for Trade Negotiations, with the rank of Ambassador', and the presiding officer stated 'Without objection, the nomination is considered and confirmed.'

title: Congressional Record, Senate, 8 May 1972, pp. 16126-16127 (bound edition, 1972 part 13)
